guide.title: Training intent
guide.body: Build cardiovascular fitness, aerobic endurance, general strength and muscle mass. Tuesday is the measurable hard interval day; Friday is flexible CrossFit and optional accessories. Avoid treating HRV or VO₂ max as a sole longevity score.

guide.title: Aerobic minimum
guide.body: Thursday 50–65 min and Saturday 60–75 min deliver approximately 110–140 min of dedicated easy aerobic exercise. Tuesday 4 × 4 and Friday WOD add vigorous work but not all WOD minutes are aerobic. Add optional 10–30 min easy walking/rowing as recovery permits; 150 min Zone 2 is not a biological threshold.

guide.title: Intensity
guide.body: Zone 2 should remain conversational (roughly RPE 3–4/10); don't use an unverified fixed heart-rate cutoff. Tuesday 4 × 4 is RPE 8–9 and repeatable watts. Friday may be hard but needn't be maximal every week.

guide.title: EMOM warm-ups
guide.body: Strength days and Friday use six-minute movement-specific EMOMs, kept easy. Perform separate ascending barbell warm-up sets before working loads. Tuesday needs a progressive aerobic warm-up.

guide.title: Progressive overload
guide.body: For primary strength exercises use 1–3 repetitions in reserve. Add reps within prescribed ranges, then increase load by the smallest practical increment when all sets are clean. No compulsory paused-bench 100 kg specialization.

guide.title: Hypertrophy plateau
guide.body: Track working sets, loads/reps, weekly average body weight and optional circumference/photos for 8–12 weeks. Adequate protein alone does not ensure mass gain; energy availability and recovery matter. Add sets only if performance and recovery allow.

guide.title: Friday WOD rules
guide.body: Use one Solo or Team WOD. The optional 12–18 min accessory block is not compulsory; skip or change it when movements overlap the WOD. Scale reps, loads and time caps; protect Saturday's easy run.

guide.title: Equipment
guide.body: Available: RowErg, SkiErg, racks, pull-up/dip bars, barbells, dumbbells, kettlebells, bench, box and mats. No cable station, leg-curl machine, wall balls, ropes, rings or treadmill assumed.

guide.title: Fatigue adjustment
guide.body: If Tuesday intervals decline after Monday squats, reduce Monday squats to 2 sets. If Wednesday deadlift warm-ups feel unusually heavy, do only 2 working sets. After a very demanding Friday WOD, shorten Saturday's run or walk instead.

guide.title: Nutrition and sleep
guide.body: Maintain adequate overall calories, protein and carbohydrate availability for strength and interval training. Prioritize consistent sleep and recovery, not supplements or HRV chasing.
